theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a b : Euclid P), ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖b‖ = 1 → a ≠ b → b ≠ -a → ∃ (ℓ : ℝ) (u : Euclid P), 0 < ℓ ∧ ‖a - b‖ = ℓ ∧ ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ b + ℓ • u = a ∧ (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ, ‖b + s • u‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ (e : Euclid P) (s₁ s₂ t₁ t₂ : ℝ), b + s₁ • u = t₁ • e → b + s₂ • u = t₂ • e → s₁ = s₂
